title: Buruk👎🏻Jangan membeli aplikasi ini!
body: There have been numerous updates since my complaint, but synchronization between devices still doesn't work properly—the developers are ignoring our feedback and do not seem to care about user convenience. Aplikasi ini sangat buruk. Semua ulasan positif ditulis oleh pengembangnya sendiri. Tidak mungkin untuk mengatur pelacak untuk interval tertentu, misalnya dari 4 hingga 12 Agustus, untuk minum probiotik sekali sehari. Aplikasi yang dirancang dengan buruk ini hanya memungkinkan pengaturan tanggal mulai (saya mengatur 4 Agustus), tetapi saya tidak dapat mengatur tanggal akhir (11 Agustus). Aplikasi ini tidak cocok untuk pelacakan kebiasaan. Pengembang mengabaikan keluhan pengguna. Sinkronisasi antar perangkat tidak berfungsi. Jika Anda membuat pelacak di satu perangkat, itu tidak muncul di perangkat lain. Selain itu, jika Anda menandai pelacak sebagai selesai di satu perangkat, notifikasi tidak hilang di perangkat lain, dan Anda harus menandai secara manual sebagai selesai di perangkat kedua juga. Sinkronisasi tidak berfungsi! Pengembang tidak peduli dengan pengguna mereka! The application is terrible. The developers ignore user complaints. Synchronization between devices doesn't work. If you create a tracker on one device, it doesn't appear on the other. Additionally, if you mark a tracker as completed on one device, the notification doesn't disappear on the other, and you have to manually mark it as completed on the second device as well. Synchronization is broken! The developers don't care about their users! Do not purchase this app! All positive reviews were written by the developer themselves. It is impossible to set up a tracker for a specific interval, for example, from August 4 to August 12, to take a probiotic once a day. This poorly designed app only allows setting a start date (I set August 4), but I was unable to set an end date (August 11). The app is not suitable for habit tracking.
author: Rammzes2

title: Tidak bagus. Glitches a lot. Dont buy it!
body: The application has a synchronization bug, where if you have already checked off a habit on one device, you still receive a reminder to mark the habit on another device. WHY? All devices should automatically acknowledge the action according to synchronization, and notifications should not be sent to other devices if it has already been marked on one of them. However, all devices will still notify you, and by marking them, you will enter duplicated or tripled notes, even though it should have been done just once. DO NOT BUY this flawed application, where developers don't care about the users and ignore feedback. And the interface looks like it's from the 1990s—boring and outdated. . Terjemahan antarmuka ke bahasa Rusia sangat buruk. Pelacak kebiasaan itu bagus, tetapi untuk mencapai tujuan keuangan, lebih baik menggunakan aplikasi keuangan. Misalnya, aplikasi "Accounting Finance" mampu tidak hanya melacaknya tetapi juga mengintegrasikannya dengan rekening bank dan analitik. A habit tracker is good, but for achieving financial goals, it's better to use a financial app. For instance, the “Accounting Finance” app is capable not only of tracking them but also of integrating them with your bank account and analytics.
